        description = "Detects dynamically generated Cobalt Strike beacon binaries"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        date = "2026-04-09"
    strings:
        $x64_beacon_config = { 66 01 ?? 8B C6 48 8B D9 8B 53 04 8B CB } // Common x64 beacon config pattern

        $http_methods = "GET" fullword ascii
        $c2_mutex = "MSCTF.Asm.{" wide

        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and // PE
        3 of ($x64*, $stage_prep, $http_methods, $c2_mutex)
}
